lines.text: Many learners say: I bought a book in the library.
Better: I bought a book in the bookstore.
You buy books in a bookstore.
Bookstore! I buy books in a bookstore.

data.wrong: I bought a book in the library.
data.right: I bought a book in the bookstore.
data.why: You buy books in a bookstore.

native.caption: Falso amigo clásico 📚 No digas “I bought a book in the library.”, sino “I bought a book in the bookstore.”. ¡Escucha a Carlos y repite! Practica más en la app Lexkite.
native.comment: Respuesta: “bookstore”. “Library” significa biblioteca. Practica más con un quiz gratis aquí: {link}

en.tip: False friend: “library” is “biblioteca”. A “librería” is a “bookstore”.
en.caption: Classic false friend! Do not say “I bought a book in the library.”, say “I bought a book in the bookstore.”. Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
